source_review.notes: Checked all eight references for identity, version, and claimed scope. Sadalage and Fowler supports version-controlled migrations, unique identifiers, ledgers, small changes, database/application coordination, and mixed versions. Current PostgreSQL 18 ALTER TABLE and CREATE INDEX documentation supports operation-specific locks, concurrent-build restrictions, multiple scans/waits, and invalid-index failure state; current PostgreSQL constraints documentation supports relational semantics. MySQL 8.4 documents metadata locks, online DML logs, temporary-space, rollback, and replica limitations. Humble and Farley, Kleppmann, and Ambler/Sadalage support durable pipeline, compatibility, and transition-period reasoning. Checked 2026-09-06.
